blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 Celebrated as “the fastest Lebanese woman in history,” Aziza Sbaity took to the track at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games despite war-related hardship, using sports as a platform to promote equality and combat discrimination. Born in Liberia to a Liberian mother and Lebanese father, the 34-year-old Sbaity moved to Lebanon in her childhood as the African nation’s civil war intensified. The Asian Games are taking place amid ongoing fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah militants in Lebanon.
